meta.title: The Forest
meta.note: Walk the woods with a lantern, dig down with the moles, sail or fly out to the islands, and bundle up for the peaks.

locations.name: Icicle's Palace
locations.curatedDescription: Far up past the clouds, on the pointiest peak of a snow-covered mountain range, stands the shimmering ice castle of Icicle — the titanic, ancient white dragon. Ring the doorbell (ding-dong!) and he'll welcome you in for frozen treats — popsicles, ice cream, and ice cubes stirred in a cup until they're just right. He keeps it very neat, clean, and sparkly-polished, and mostly lives up there all alone at the very top of the world.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: Icicle and Dimitar. Icicle and Dimitar. I'm visiting you. I'm visiting. I'm gonna go visit Icicle and Dimitar. So, so I put on my snow pants, jacket, and hat, and rang Icicle's doorbell when I flew there with my cape. Ding-dong, Icicle.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: "Wow, I didn't know there was an ice festival. I didn't even know there were other ice dragons. I'm used to just living here all alone at the top of the mountain in my ice castle," said Icicle. "I'm so glad to know there's a festival I can go to. And you said it's tomorrow?"

locations.name: Crystal Mountain
locations.curatedDescription: A mountain made entirely of crystal: purple at the bottom with stairs cut into the side, pink past the wibbly-wobbly crystal bridge over the crevasse, and a tunnel through its middle that glows red, orange, yellow, green and purple. The gentle Caretaker of Crystal Mountain looks after it, magical birds come here for the crystals that help them fly, and every lost gemstone creature knows it as the place it was born. Alexander the cat stands guard.

quotes.speaker: Izzy
quotes.text: I know, I know where there's other crystals, said Isabella to the rock, and you might want to go to care- to the caretaker of Crystal Mountain, 'cause there's lots of crystals there.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: Holding hands. And it was a beautiful, bright, sunny day as they began their ascent. Ascent means going up, up the side of the Crystal Mountain. And the first part of it that they climbed was a beautiful purple crystal, and it had stairs cut into the side, and so it was easy for them to climb.

locations.name: Peacock's Tower
locations.curatedDescription: Up on a great green hill where the forest paths climb into the open, the gray stone castle of Peacock the Wizard lifts its tall tower over the treetops. An elephant opens the gate, a spiral staircase goes clunk-clunk-clunk all the way up, and at the very top is Peacock's cozy room with a fireplace, games and a nice rug. Every quest through the woods seems to begin or end here.

quotes.speaker: Dad
quotes.text: And the elephant said, "Ah, the wizard is at home upstairs at the top of his tower. You may follow those stairs up to visit Peacock the Wizard."

locations.name: Seeker's Castle
locations.curatedDescription: Where the woods end at the sea cliffs stands Seeker's castle: an unassuming front door with a ding-dong doorbell, a tower high enough to see all the way out to Square Island, a stone sky ship parked up top, and the famous potion closet, shelf upon dusty shelf of shimmering bottles, one for every world. Fire potions, water potions, prehistoric-land potions... a lot of adventures start by picking one.

locations.name: Hattie's Workshop
locations.curatedDescription: The Workshop of Hats, in the weathered heart of a hollow tree in the middle of the woods. Inside is a cheerful clutter of measuring tapes, colored scissors, glue, wet pigments and scavenged shells, plus an oven for baking hats, all lit by baskets of glowing red, orange and yellow mushrooms. It smells of cedar, ink and peanut butter toast, and every hat that matters in the forest was made here.

locations.name: Isabella's House
locations.curatedDescription: At the edge of the woods is Isabella's own house: a stone patio and a swing set out back, a driveway just right for parking a sky ship, a sunroom where Silver the cat catches flies, and a basement full of bins of storybooks. Seeker keeps a special Izzy's House potion for visiting, and it is the place every adventure eventually comes home to.

locations.name: Circular Island
locations.curatedDescription: A perfectly round island far out across the ocean, with ordinary sandy beaches all around the edge, forests and dragonet villages, and a rumbling volcano-mountain in the middle. Dimitar's little castle sits on its side. This is the home of the dragonets, of the Circular Island Dragon Club, and of the grandest singing competitions in all the land. Once Icicle froze the whole thing solid, and it took salt to melt it.

locations.name: Rainbow Island
locations.curatedDescription: Far across the ocean, a sailing trip away, is the island of the Rainbow Forest. Its beach is pink, purple, silver and gold, its sunsets turn every shade of the rainbow, and the forest beyond grows in rings of color: a red part, an orange part (with orange sand), and on through yellow, green, blue, pink, purple, silver and gold. The Floofers and many colorful creatures shelter here.

locations.name: The Mole Family's Tunnel
locations.curatedDescription: The warm, cozy home of the Mischief Mole family, dug in under the woods: windows, stairs, lamps, a bookcase, and chairs so comfy that every mole who sits down falls asleep mid-sentence. Everyone snuggles up here while Papa Mole reads bedtime chapters from the great big book of Dimitar the Dragon, and when a volcano booms outside, the door shuts tight and keeps everybody safe. It is, officially, the best mole hole ever.

locations.name: Uncle Grisco's Laboratory
locations.curatedDescription: Uncle Grisco's sprawling underground home and laboratory: low amber-lit ceilings of packed earth and reinforced timber, the smell of damp clay mixed with a faint whiff of robot ozone. The local moles congregate here for interesting discussions, science, and — when Zigzag the robot gets going — the Cornebyborn dance, shadows flickering on the cavern walls.

locations.name: The Ant Kingdom
locations.curatedDescription: Deeper than the mole tunnels, past the muck and the deep dark cave, lies a whole city underground: the Kingdom of the Ants. The clever ants build little buildings and scurry all around, and their friends the worms wiggle through the dirt between them. The Mischief Moles came down here hunting for Elliot the Elephant's missing gem, and found it buried deeper still.
